🚑 Quality checks and remaining work

  1. Resolve category uncertainty without discarding verified offers
    344 products still need category evidence. Their valid offers remain browsable under Needs category review; they are excluded from automatic meal matching.
  2. Recover source data before guessing from images

    Use reliable source fields like Fresh Produce, retailer breadcrumbs, and product-detail metadata before adding keyword rules that can move drinks, supplements, or personal care into the wrong shelf.

retailer_description"One step. Three acids. Results that build. Andalou's Resurfacing Triple Acid Exfoliating Toner is a milky, leave-on 5% AHA toner that addresses texture, pore appearance, and the look of dark spots all at once — because your skin deserves more than a single-acid solution. Powered by Fruit Science™, glycolic, lactic, and mandelic acids each do a different job: glycolic exfoliates at the surface, lactic smooths and supports hydration, mandelic gently addresses uneven tone. Niacinamide visibly refines pore appearance while pineapple and papaya enzymes lift dull surface buildup. The result is skin that looks smoother, more even-toned, and visibly refreshed — no rinsing required. Rooted in renewal and refined by science — at Andalou, our patented Fruit Science™ innovation is clinically proven to support skin's natural wisdom. We don't fight change. We formulate for it. Suitable for sensitive skin. Dermatologist tested. Begin 1–2 uses weekly, increasing to daily as tolerated. Sunburn Alert: This product contains alpha hydroxy acids (AHAs). Apply a broad-spectrum sunscreen daily while using this product and for one week after. AHAs may increase skin's sensitivity to sun exposure. Formulated without parabens, sulfates, phthalates, or other harmful additives. Cruelty free."

retailer_description"Annie's Frozen Uncured Pepperoni Mini Pizza Bagels combine delicious cheese, zesty tomato sauce and savory uncured pepperoni for a crunchy bagel snack! Enjoy bite-sized mini bagels made with cheese, organic flour, and tomatoes. This snack contains no artificial flavors or synthetic colors, and no nitrates or nitrites added*. These mini pizza bagels are made with whole grains. Simply take some out of the freezer and put them in the oven, toaster oven, or microwave. In just a few minutes, you'll have delicious bites that'll be a hit with the whole household! Perfect for busy families, they make a great snack, addition to lunch, or appetizers before dinner. You'll love how easy they are to heat and enjoy! Annie's makes products in over 20 family-friendly categories, from fruit flavored snacks and cereal to mac and cheese. For busy bunnies and families on the go, we help make life a little easier and more delicious by spreading goodness through tasty foods and kindness to the planet. *Except those naturally occurring in cultured celery juice powder and sea salt. See nutrition information for sodium content."

retailer_product_type"DAIRY_BASED_CHEESE"
retailer_department"gl_fresh_perishable"
retailer_description"Tillamook Whole Milk Mozzarella Snack Portions are your lunch's new favorite friend. Made using a traditional make process for full flavor in every bite, these whole milk low moisture mozzarella cheese snacks contain 5g of protein in each snack portion to provide full flavor in a satisfying snack. Say hello to fuller flavor with this perfectly rich mozzarella snacking cheese, consciously crafted with whole milk for a rich flavor, pre-portioned and individually packaged so you can enjoy delicious mozzarella bites at home, school, work or anywhere you go. These portable and convenient whole milk mozzarella cheese snacks are perfect for a yummy, quick cheese snack on the go and are sure to be a crowd-pleaser with family and friends. Pasteurized and made from high-quality milk from cows not treated with rBST*, these whole milk Tillamook Cheese Snacks never include artificial flavors or preservatives. Better yet, you can be assured that each purchase you make helps support Tillamook County Creamery Association in their pursuit to do right. As a Certified B Corp, Tillamook County Creamery Association is committed to being good stewards of cows and farms, of people and products, their communities and the environment. With over 110 years of quality cheese-making experience, Tillamook Whole Milk Mozzarella Cheese Snacks have a taste to remember. Do Right By Every Bite. *The FDA has stated that no significant difference has been shown between milk derived from rBST treated and non-rBST treated cows."

retailer_description"Navitas Organics Pomegranate Powder is a unique and versatile way to enjoy the delicious taste and antioxidant benefits of pomegranate year-round. A perfectly sweet-tart powder, Navitas Organics Pomegranate Powder is made from carefully removing and juicing the nutrient-rich seeds from the ripened organic pomegranate fruit. The juice is then carefully freeze-dried to preserve its nutritional integrity. Treasured since ancient times, the pomegranate is particularly revered for containing the unique antioxidant ellagic acid, which helps support cellular health and longevity. Navitas Organics Pomegranate Powder has a bright, sweet taste that is fantastic in smoothies, yogurt, oatmeal, marinades, desserts, salad dressings and baked goods. USDA Organic, Non-GMO, Kosher, vegan, gluten-free."

retailer_department"gl_grocery"
retailer_description"Indulge in the creamy, mild flavor of Whole Foods Market Muenster Cheese. This premium 16-ounce package delivers the perfect balance of softness and texture that makes Muenster a beloved choice for sandwiches, burgers, and cheese boards. With its characteristic orange rind and pale interior, this semi-soft cheese melts beautifully, making it ideal for grilled cheese sandwiches or adding a gooey layer to your favorite dishes. Crafted with care, Whole Foods Market Muenster maintains the traditional quality you expect while offering versatility for both cooking and snacking. Enjoy it sliced with crackers, melted over potatoes, or incorporated into your favorite recipes for a touch of mild, buttery goodness that complements rather than overpowers other flavors."

retailer_description"At ALOHA, we believe that plants are the ultimate source of nourishment, and that real foods should be really convenient. So when you’re looking for a great tasting, organic, plant-based protein boost, we’ve got you covered. ALOHA protein bars use simple, organic ingredients that are naturally packed with the tools your body needs to do its best: protein, iron, fiber, and healthy fats. With 14g clean protein and only 5g of natural sugar, ALOHA’s protein bars are the perfect, healthy snack to tide you over. Our thoughtfully selected, plant-based protein is sourced from a balanced mix of organic pumpkin seed and organic brown rice, to deliver steady energy that will carry you through the day without the dreaded sugar crash. ALOHA’s organic, plant-based products are vegan, non-GMO, gluten-free, soy-free, dairy-free lactose-free, stevia-free, high protein, Kosher Certified and USDA certified organic. ALOHA checks the all the boxes, so you can enjoy a tasty, nutritious snack without hesitation. All of our protein bars and protein products are made free of artificial ingredients and free of sugar alcohols, because we know that what you eat and how you feel are intimately connected. ALOHA’s organic, plant-based Chocolate Mint protein bars use a short line of organic, whole-food ingredients that are delicious and self-explanatory: like real, organic dark chocolate, organic cashew butter, and organic peppermint oil. The perfect protein bar for when you’re between meetings, warming up for the gym or cooling down, on the road, taking a pit-stop on your weekend cycle, or looking for an easy, nutritious option at home. The search for a healthy, satisfying, go-to snack is over: sit back and enjoy a great tasting, rejuvenating ALOHA protein bar."

retailer_description"Annie's Frozen Uncured Pepperoni Mini Pizza Bagels combine delicious cheese, zesty tomato sauce and savory uncured pepperoni for a crunchy bagel snack! Enjoy bite-sized mini bagels made with cheese, organic flour, and tomatoes. This snack contains no artificial flavors or synthetic colors, and no nitrates or nitrites added*. These mini pizza bagels are made with whole grains. Simply take some out of the freezer and put them in the oven, toaster oven, or microwave. In just a few minutes, you'll have delicious bites that'll be a hit with the whole household! Perfect for busy families, they make a great snack, addition to lunch, or appetizers before dinner. You'll love how easy they are to heat and enjoy! Annie's makes products in over 20 family-friendly categories, from fruit flavored snacks and cereal to mac and cheese. For busy bunnies and families on the go, we help make life a little easier and more delicious by spreading goodness through tasty foods and kindness to the planet. *Except those naturally occurring in cultured celery juice powder and sea salt. See nutrition information for sodium content."

retailer_description"Organic snacks you can bring on-the-go? Say hello to Annie's Chocolate Chip Chewy Granola Bars. Best of all, Annie's Chocolate Chip Chewy Bars feature 8g of whole grain per serving. And like all Annie's granola bars, they're made with goodness. That means no artificial flavors or synthetic colors. Annie's makes products in over 20 family-friendly categories, from fruit-flavored snacks and cereal to mac and cheese. For busy bunnies and families on the go, we help make life a little easier and more delicious by spreading goodness through tasty foods and kindness to the planet. 8g whole grain per serving. At least 48g recommended daily."

retailer_description"Epic's bone broth is the worlds first ready to heat beverage of its kind! we take great pride in how we prepare our broth and take extra steps to cook our bones in a traditional fashion, which relies on low simmering for long durations.
